aurora-sleep-aurora-hybrid.label: Great edge support
aurora-sleep-aurora-hybrid.snippet: The edge support is fantastic, we never feel like we'll roll off even sitting right on the side.

aurora-sleep-aurora-hybrid.label: Good motion isolation
aurora-sleep-aurora-hybrid.snippet: I barely notice when my partner gets up at night, motion isolation is great.

cloudline-cloudline-original.label: Sleeps hot
cloudline-cloudline-original.snippet: I run hot on this one, wish it slept cooler.

cloudline-cloudline-original.label: Good pressure relief
cloudline-cloudline-original.snippet: Contours to my hips and shoulder without ever feeling stuck, great pressure relief.

terrafoam-terrafoam-cool.label: Sleeps cool
terrafoam-terrafoam-cool.snippet: Stays cool all night which surprised me for a foam mattress.

terrafoam-terrafoam-cool.label: Too firm
terrafoam-terrafoam-cool.snippet: Way too firm for my side-sleeping shoulder, definitely too firm out of the box.

nimbus-nimbus-pocket-coil.label: Great value
nimbus-nimbus-pocket-coil.snippet: Great value for a mattress in this price range, would recommend to a friend.

nimbus-nimbus-pocket-coil.label: Sags after time
nimbus-nimbus-pocket-coil.snippet: After about eight months it started to sag right in the middle of the bed.

stratus-stratus-latex-hybrid.label: Off-gassing / chemical smell
stratus-stratus-latex-hybrid.snippet: There was a strange smell when we unboxed it, definitely some off-gassing the first week.

stratus-stratus-latex-hybrid.label: Weak edge support
stratus-stratus-latex-hybrid.snippet: Edge support could be better, I feel like I might roll off if I sit near the side.

baseline-baseline-firm-innerspring.label: Too firm
baseline-baseline-firm-innerspring.snippet: Definitely too firm for anyone who likes a softer feel, my hips ached the first few nights.

drift-drift-plush-foam.label: Off-gassing / chemical smell
drift-drift-plush-foam.snippet: We could smell a chemical odor when we first unboxed it, took a few days to fade.

drift-drift-plush-foam.label: Too soft
drift-drift-plush-foam.snippet: Sinks in a lot, sometimes feels like there's no support at all for my lower back.

anchor-anchor-hybrid-support.label: Good motion isolation
anchor-anchor-hybrid-support.snippet: My partner moves around a lot and I don't feel a thing, great motion isolation on this one.

coastal-coastal-cool-gel-foam.label: Sleeps hot
coastal-coastal-cool-gel-foam.snippet: This one runs really hot, I wake up sweaty most nights even with the gel foam.

summit-summit-innerspring-classic.label: Sags after time
summit-summit-innerspring-classic.snippet: Started sagging after about a year of regular use, disappointing for an innerspring.

halcyon-halcyon-hybrid-plus.label: Great edge support
halcyon-halcyon-hybrid-plus.snippet: Really solid edge support, great for sitting on the side to put on shoes in the morning.

vale-vale-budget-foam.label: Too firm
vale-vale-budget-foam.snippet: A bit too firm out of the box but softened slightly after a few weeks of use.
